notes.title: SKYRAID Major Content Update and Multiplayer Demo!
notes.notes:
SKYRAID - Major Update: New Planes, New Modes, and Free Demo!

Raiders, prepare for takeoff!

We’re thrilled to announce SKYRAID’s first major update, which will be more accommodating to smaller groups of players and allow more people to experience SKYRAID than ever before! (And of course new content! Duh!)

[u]✈️ New Planes[/u]
Take flight in two brand-new planes:
[list]
[*] Tier 1: WARHAWK – an American fighter plane, featuring a single-engine prop, low-wings, rugged looks and economical performance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42372153/79d5cbe6983261c54609ff4f652dd41ba541d1ab.png[/img]
[*] Tier 3: FAGOT – a Soviet-era, swept-wing, single-seat fighter jet known for its simplicity and effectiveness.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42372153/d0c97b34a8d2a8899665b360eb074744e545fbec.png[/img]
[/list]
[u]🚁 New Single-Lane and Two-Lane Modes[/u]
You asked, we delivered! Alongside the signature 3-lane mode, you can jump into the new single-lane or dual-lane modes! Now you can enjoy the game more with smaller groups of players than what is generally needed for a 3-lane match.

[u]🎮 Multiplayer Demo Version [b]OUT NOW![/b][/u]
Interested in trying the game or playing casually with friends? Try it out for free! The Demo version of the game will grant access to a limited selection of 5 planes that cycle weekly. Any currency earned in the Demo will carry over to the Full version so you can keep your progress. Unfortunately due to technical limitations, [b]Demo players will only be able to play online with other folks who are also using the Demo version.[/b]

[u]✈️ Take to the Skies Today![/u]
Hop in now and start blasting! Whether you're an ace raider or a fresh cadet, there's never been a better time to fly with us in SKYRAID!

[b]Please note! -[/b] We have temporarily disabled "Assignments", as they are hard-coded for first-come first-serve 3-lane matches and won't start until 12 players are present and ready. For now, please use "Custom" games, which will allow you to select any number of lanes and start with any number of players!

See you in the skies, raiders!
-Wip3ou7

notes.title: Version B1.011
notes.notes:
[b]Version B1.011[/b]

[u]New:[/u]
[list]
[*] New Tier 3 jet, “Meteor”!
[*] Predator drone kills now award an additional clock-based Merit bonus, like Helicopters.
[*] Clients can now see their ping to the game host.
[*] You may now preview additional paintjobs for airplanes that you have not yet purchased.
[/list]

[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] New players who complete the tutorial will achieve “Certified” status. Old players, who completed the tutorial, can now become “Certified” by redoing any portion of the tutorial.
[*] The Predator drone’s radar blip is now significantly larger. Its radar has a greater scan radius revealing more enemy positions and health pickups.
[*] Submitted orders for airplane payload is checked on the server for compatibility, and capacity violations and merit.
[*] Collision animations are now issued server side (hopefully this will help collisions look more consistent across all clients)
[*] Changed “InsufficientFunds” warning to “Insufficient Merit”.
[/list]

[u]Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] An airplane that is killed while the pilot is disconnected from the game will now go through health states and collide with other objects properly.
[*] Takeoff button now appears correctly when reconnecting.
[*] Mission clock now appears correctly after reconnecting.
[*] Fixed Apache Contest timer partially blocking the takeoff button.
[*] Predator drone will now fly to the playing altitude more quickly, accurately, and reliably.
[*] Presets and the Hangar have been giving us some trouble, but we believe they are now reliably working as intended.
[*] We’re still tracking cases in which the Hangar can produce an “InvalidBuy” or “Duplicate Plane” error. If you encounter these, please leave a bug report in Discord.
[*] Adjusted the network code for the Predator drone. It should have a more accurate position between clients now.
[*] Fixed another case in which two UFOs could spawn at the same time.
[*] Achievement “Aces High” and its related stat, “Airplanes Killed” are now tracked correctly.
[*] Achievements related to killing airplanes with the various types of guided missiles should now be working correctly.
[*] Burst Missiles will now properly report to the hit-feed, kill-feed, and achievement stats for kills and guidance type.
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
A quick update with some nice adjustments to compliment yesterdays patch. Enjoy!

[b]B1.006[/b]

[u]New[/u]:
[list]
[*] When you destroy another aircraft, the exact amount of Merit earned is displayed at the top of the screen.
[*] You will now be notified if your order hasn’t been Submitted when clicking Take-Off, or if you haven’t added a plane when clicking Submit.
[/list]
[u]Changes[/u]:
[list]
[*] Changed the order of categories in the Arsenal.
[*] Removed “Capacity Exceeded” message in the Hangar. Instead, a message will inform you of that equipment type’s maximum capacity.
[*] Further tuning of the Tutorial.
[/list]
[u]Fixes[/u]:
[list]
[*] Fixed Clout balance not being updated upon entering the Arsenal.
[*] Fixed drop-down notifications blocking clicks (partially obscured the Take-Off button).
[/list]

notes.title: SKYRAID update!
notes.notes:
[b]Version: Beta 1.004[/b]

[u]General Changes[/u]:
[list]
[*] Tier 5 planes can no longer use Tier 3 equipment.
[*] Predator drone minimap vision radius increased to 500 (from 250).
[*] Increased the size of the “Unspent Skill Point” notification.
[*] Changed the appearance of the “No Server Heartbeat” warning.
[*] Kill Feed messages will now display for 10 seconds instead of 6.
[*] Hit Feed messages will now display for 5 seconds instead of 6.
[*] Simplified Tutorial messages prompting lesson completion.
[*] In the Options > Log page, the “Snapshot” button now reads “Export”.
[/list]
[u]Hangar Changes[/u]:
[list]
[*] When an owned item in the Hangar is set to be replaced by a new item of a different kind, the quantity of the replaced item is shown in red.
[*] The “Save” and “Load” Preset buttons in the Hangar have been swapped. This should help with not accidentally saving over your existing Presets when shopping quickly :)
[*] The “Reset Preview” button is now called “Match Item” and is used like an eyedropper tool to match the item in the preview panel to be the same item as your currently selected equipment panel.
[*] You can now add missiles to your loadout before adding a plane, and save that loadout to a Preset. However, you will still not be able to Submit an order without a Plane or with incompatible weapons.
[*] Hangar button labels have been changed to make keyboard and controller prompts more consistent with each other.
[/list]
[u]Detailed Achievement tracking[/u]
[list]
[*] All Achievements are now driven by Steam Stats, so progress towards individual Achievements can be viewed on your Steam profile.
[*] Steam Overlay will now notify you of progress towards achievements (Some achievements are still not fully implemented).
[/list]
[u]General Fixes[/u]:
[list]
[*] You will now automatically Unready properly if you visit the Arsenal or the Options while you are set as Ready in the Lobby.
[*] Fixed Kill Feed names for Predator drones.
[*] Fixed dark square artifacting around text in the Kill Feed.
[*] Fixed Hit Feed not showing Hits that result in a Kill.
[*] When no airplanes are owned, the Paint list in the Arsenal is now blank, instead of showing “TEXT”
[*] Fixed missiles going through airplanes in Tutorial lessons about counter-measures.
[*] Airplanes only available in the Development branch will no longer cause errors in the Retail branch.
[/list]
[u]Hangar Fixes[/u]:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could result in corrupted Preset slots.
- It is strongly advised that you re-create & re-save your loadout Presets.
[*] Presets will no longer suggest selling equipment if you already have more of the same item than the preset demands (unless it’s a missile which is equipped to a different Panel than what matches the Preset - we’ll address that in the future).
[*] If you attempt to load a preset containing a plane you no longer have access to (a previously issued plane which is not currently issued), the plane will be excluded from the loadout automatically and you will be notified at the top of the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused an Invalid Plane error after death.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause negative inventory quantities.
[*] Clicking the “Preset” buttons with the mouse no longer affects the focus of Hangar equipment panels.
[*] Fixed Loading a Preset with incompatible items prevents you from subtracting from those items.
[/list]
